fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB ALP CEN 01/2025 CBT-II Result 2026 – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the CBT II Result for the Non Technical Popular Categories Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) posts. RRB has invited huge number of vacancies for Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) post recruitment during the 12 April 2025, to 19 May 2025. There were 10,970 posts were called for the hiring of RRB ALP in various trades. The CBT-II examination was conducted on 28 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for CBT-II examination can download their RRB ALP 01/2025 CBT-II Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 12 April 2025
  • Application Start Date : 12 April 2025
  • Last Date : 19 May 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 May 2025
  • Correction / Modified Form : 22-31 May 2025
  • Application Status : 05 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 13, 16, 17 & 18 February 2026
  • Exam City Details : 03 February 2026
  • Admit Card : 09 February 2026
  • Re Scheduled Exam Date : 11 March 2026
  • Exam City Details : 06 March 2026
  • Admit Card : 04 Days Before Exam
  • Answer Key Available On : 20 March 2026
  • Result Available : 12 June 2026
  • CBT II Exam Date : 28 July 2026
  • CBT-II Exam City Details : 18 July 2026
  • CBT-II Admit Card : 24 July 2026
  • CBT-II Answer Key : 05 August 2026
  • CBT-II Result : 01 October 2026
  • CBAT Exam Date : 30 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/–
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam) :
  • General : Rs. 400/–
  • OBC, EWS, SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
